ja.text:

それを、改めて突きつけられた。

en.text: It hit home. No, I’d known all along. She’d just made me face it again.

en.text: Toritani meant what she said.

ja.text:

性に対する、少女的な潔癖さとでも言えばいいのか。

en.text: There is a peculiar fastidiousness in Toritani—an almost girlish fastidiousness about sex.
en.html: There is a peculiar fastidiousness in Toritani—an almost girlish fastidiousness about sex.

ja.text: だからこそ、性愛と芸術を完全に切り離してみることもできる。

en.text: Perhaps that very purity allows her to separate erotic desire from art completely.

en.text: When she draws a nude, I doubt she feels so much as a flicker of lust.

en.text: Then again, a life-drawing session leaves little leisure for lust in the first place.
en.html: Then again, a life-drawing session leaves little leisure for lust in the first place.

ごくプライベートな、一対一の場であるなら
可能性はなきにしもあらずだが……それはともかく。

en.text: In a wholly private session, alone with the model, the possibility might not be quite zero. But that is beside the point.

en.text: Knowing Toritani, she could not have made such an offer without extraordinary resolve.
en.html: Knowing Toritani, she could not have made such an offer without extraordinary resolve.

ja.text: それだけ、強く、鳥谷は俺に絵を描いて欲しいと望んでいるのだ。
